title: Slideomatic Field Guide
subtitle: Build beautiful decks right in your browser

headline: This deck is the manual
body: Use the **arrow keys** to move between slides. Press `?` any time to see every keyboard shortcut.
Each slide walks you through a feature — read it, try it. Nothing saves to a server; all edits live in your browser until you export.
By the end of this guide you'll know how to create slides, change layouts, add images, apply themes, and export your finished deck.

pillars.title: Navigate
pillars.text: **Arrow keys** move between slides. **Home** and **End** jump to the first or last slide. **Shift + Arrow** skips five at a time.

pillars.title: Edit
pillars.text: Press **E** to open the edit drawer. Change text, swap layouts, upload images — everything updates live on screen.

pillars.title: Theme
pillars.text: Press **T** to randomize the theme instantly, or open the edit drawer to browse presets and fine-tune colours.

pillars.title: Export
pillars.text: Press **D** to download your deck as JSON. Use **Download PDF** in the edit drawer for a printable version.

headline: Press **E** to edit anything
body: The edit drawer is your control centre. It slides in from the right and has three tabs:
**Content** tab: edit titles, body text, badges, quotes, and captions. Changes save automatically when you click away.

**Layouts** tab: swap this slide to any of the available types — standard, quote, gallery, pillars, split, grid, typeface, or image. You can also add brand-new slides from here, already styled and ready to fill in.
**Media** tab: upload images, compress them, and add captions. You'll also find the **Download PDF** button here.

headline: Build your deck one slide at a time
body: Open the edit drawer with **E**, then go to the **Layouts** tab. Pick any slide type and a new slide appears right after the current one.
Want to duplicate the slide you're on? Press **Alt + Arrow Right** (or **Option + Arrow Right** on Mac) to clone it instantly.
To reorder slides, use the overview grid (**O**) to see the whole deck at a glance, then rearrange from there.
There's no limit on how many slides you can add. Go wild — you can always trim later.

left.headline: Left side
left.body: Split slides are great for comparisons, before/after, or pairing an image with text. Each column stands on its own.

right.headline: Right side
right.body: Use the edit drawer to fill each column independently. Split is one of the available slide types you can pick from the Layouts tab.

headline: Keep the rhythm weird
body: Standard, quote, gallery, pillars, typeface, split, grid, image — all one click away in the Layouts tab.

headline: Fonts are mood swings
body: Override the font on any slide using the edit drawer or by setting the `font` field in JSON. Presets include sans, mono, grotesk, jetbrains, and pixel.

caption: Upload images through the Media tab in the edit drawer, or set the `src` path directly in the JSON.

headline: Press **T** whenever the vibe feels stale
body: Hit **T** to instantly randomize the entire colour palette, shadows, and textures. Keep pressing until something clicks.
For more control, open the edit drawer (**E**) and browse the theme presets — Default, Gameboy, Vaporwave, Slack, and more.
Save any theme you like to your personal library so you can switch back to it later. SomaFM radio is built in too, so you can design with a soundtrack.

headline: Keep these in your fingers
body: **E** = edit drawer, **T** = randomize theme, **I** = slide index, **O** = overview grid.
**D** downloads the deck as JSON. **U** uploads one. **N** toggles speaker notes.
**Shift + Arrow** skips five slides. **Alt/Option + Arrow** duplicates the current slide.
`?` opens the full cheat sheet any time you forget.

pillars.title: JSON
pillars.text: **D** downloads the deck. **U** uploads one. The JSON format is portable — edit it by hand or share it.

pillars.title: PDF
pillars.text: Hit **Download PDF** in the edit drawer to export a printable version of your slides.

pillars.title: Local stash
pillars.text: Decks autosave to your browser's localStorage. Clear them in devtools if you need a clean slate.

pillars.title: Share
pillars.text: Use the share feature to create a link anyone can view — no account required.

quote: Ship the weird draft. Future you can clean it up.

headline: Treat Slideomatic like a sketchbook
body: Duplicate this deck, tear it apart, swap in your own content. It's yours.
Open the edit drawer (**E**), pick a layout, start typing. That's all there is to it.
Have fun, keep it human, keep it moving.
